source.citation: George Glessner (attributed), photograph of the porte-cochere (carriage) doors of the John J. Glessner House, 1800 Prairie Avenue, circa 1888. Reproduced by Glessner House, 'Porte Cochere doors'.

what_it_supplies: the design of the porte-cochere doors and the form of the opening's corner stones, circa 1888
